status: Five supplier proofs completed within stated hypotheses; ordinary RH and Dirichlet GRH reconstruction remains incomplete.

proofs.proved_scope: All-prime scalar least-valuation bound and actual admissible frame; six scalar copies suffice, padded to the retained twelve-copy maps.
internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked formal-group superadditivity, theta cancellation, leading coupling monomial, carry cost, unit-row convention and actual numerical ranges.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Transport into the comparison maps, full-chain gauge/norm and see-saw remain.

proofs.proved_scope: Equal multiplicities of full finite representations on the actual finite-isometric good spaces; definite occurrence and mass dimension bound.
internal_review: Root and two independent internal reviews checked the Harris-Labesse hypotheses and refined proof, cuspidal types, finite projectors, central separation, signs and real rank-one idempotents.
proofs.remaining_boundary: No assertion of a nonzero good space before the moment argument or of a nonzero arbitrary theta image.

proofs.proved_scope: Exact allowed and primitive counts, sharp Green masses, exact good-tuple deficit and actual two-prime discarded share at most b^(-8).
internal_review: Root independently checked the generating function, primitive orbits, Green degree normalization, tensor monotonicity, elementary totient bound and admissible size inequalities.
proofs.remaining_boundary: The Poincare kernel and its non-Bessel moments remain analytic obligations.

proofs.proved_scope: Uniform integral scale at z=1, integral period-square measure and exact Euler insertion, including imprimitive zeros.
internal_review: Root and an independent internal reviewer checked the radical modulus, Fourier coordinate count, charged scale, conjugation and quotient integration of translates.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Fully ramified analytic interpolation and the nonzero base period remain open.

proofs.proved_scope: One finite obstruction bound for the full enlarged auxiliary family at fixed local data, all ranks and precisions, with normalized coefficient extension.
internal_review: Root and an independent internal reviewer checked finite-level identification, precision saturation, coherent lifting, Liu torsion-limit application, Galois averaging and coefficient extension.
proofs.remaining_boundary: The bound is non-effective; no growing-field numerical estimate or final signed-budget bound is proved.
